english: the peak of happiness, absolute bliss
example: Den dagen jeg fikk datteren min i armene for første gang, var toppen av lykke.
example_english: The day I held my daughter in my arms for the first time was the peak of happiness.

english: to unwind, to switch off, to relax
example: Etter en lang arbeidsuke er det viktig å koble av og gjøre noe man liker.
example_english: After a long working week it is important to unwind and do something you enjoy.

english: balm for the soul, soothing comfort
example: En rolig spasertur i skogen er ren balsam for sjelen etter en stressende dag.
example_english: A quiet walk in the forest is pure balm for the soul after a stressful day.

english: to appreciate, to value
example: Jeg setter stor pris på at du tok deg tid til å hjelpe meg med prosjektet.
example_english: I really appreciate that you took the time to help me with the project.

english: to take something for granted
example: Vi tar alt for ofte friheten og helsen vår for gitt, inntil vi mister dem.
example_english: We far too often take our freedom and health for granted, until we lose them.

english: there is no doubt about, it is undeniable
example: Det er ingen tvil om at klimaendringene krever handling fra alle land i verden.
example_english: There is no doubt that climate change requires action from every country in the world.

english: fit and well, in good health
example: Etter tre ukers sykeleie var hun endelig frisk og rask og klar for jobb igjen.
example_english: After three weeks in bed she was finally fit and well and ready for work again.

english: the body protests, the body gives a signal
example: Kroppen sier fra når du driver med for mye og sover for lite over tid.
example_english: The body gives signals when you overdo things and sleep too little over time.

english: now and then, from time to time
example: Nå og da er det godt å bryte rutinen og gjøre noe spontant og uventet.
example_english: Now and then it is good to break the routine and do something spontaneous and unexpected.

english: to count on, to expect, to take into account
example: Du kan alltid regne med at hun holder sitt ord, uansett hva som skjer.
example_english: You can always count on her to keep her word, no matter what happens.

english: last but not least
example: Sist, men ikke minst, vil jeg takke alle frivillige som bidro til at arrangementet ble vellykket.
example_english: Last but not least, I want to thank all the volunteers who contributed to making the event a success.

norsk: å ha høy grad av noe
lemma: å ha høy grad av noe
english: to have a high degree of something
example: Yrket krever at man har høy grad av nøyaktighet og evne til å konsentrere seg.
example_english: The profession requires that one has a high degree of accuracy and the ability to concentrate.

english: to be aware of, to be conscious of
example: Politikerne er klar over at reformene vil møte motstand i store deler av befolkningen.
example_english: The politicians are aware that the reforms will meet resistance in large parts of the population.

english: to end up in first place, to come first
example: Ingen hadde trodd at det lille lokallaget skulle havne på førsteplass i turneringen.
example_english: Nobody had believed that the small local team would end up in first place in the tournament.

english: ideally, in an ideal world
example: Ideelt sett burde alle barn ha tilgang til høykvalitets utdanning, uavhengig av bakgrunn.
example_english: Ideally, all children should have access to high-quality education, regardless of background.

english: it is food for thought, it makes you think
example: At over halvparten av maten vi produserer kastes hvert år, er virkelig en tankevekker.
example_english: That over half of the food we produce is thrown away every year is truly food for thought.

english: to be grateful for, to be thankful for
example: Han er takknemlig for all støtten han fikk fra familien under den vanskelige perioden.
example_english: He is grateful for all the support he received from his family during the difficult period.

english: to benefit from something, to do one good
example: Det ville ha godt av deg å ta en lengre pause og tenke gjennom situasjonen nøye.
example_english: It would do you good to take a longer break and think through the situation carefully.

english: to be opposed to, to be against
example: Hun er en sterk motstander av atomkraft og har demonstrert mot det i mange år.
example_english: She is a strong opponent of nuclear power and has demonstrated against it for many years.

english: to go too far, to cross the line
example: Kritikken var berettiget i starten, men journalisten gikk altfor langt i sine påstander.
example_english: The criticism was justified at first, but the journalist went too far in his claims.

english: to make use of, to take advantage of, to utilize
example: Alle studenter bør benytte seg av de gratis veiledingstjenestene som universitetet tilbyr.
example_english: All students should make use of the free counselling services offered by the university.

english: it is unthinkable, it is inconceivable
example: Det er utenkelig at et demokratisk samfunn skulle tillate slik behandling av sine innbyggere.
example_english: It is unthinkable that a democratic society would allow such treatment of its citizens.

norsk: å få lønna til å strekke til
lemma: å få lønna til å strekke til
english: to make one's wage stretch, to make ends meet
example: Med de høye prisene er det krevende å få lønna til å strekke til for barnefamilier.
example_english: With the high prices it is challenging to make the wage stretch for families with children.

english: in safe surroundings, in a secure environment
example: Barn lærer best og trives best i trygge omgivelser der de føler seg sett og hørt.
example_english: Children learn best and thrive best in safe surroundings where they feel seen and heard.

english: to be entitled to something, to have a right to
example: Som ansatt i over to år har du krav på fem ukers betalt ferie i henhold til loven.
example_english: As an employee for over two years you are entitled to five weeks of paid holiday under the law.

english: to end up with, to wind up
example: Dersom vi ikke gjør noe nå, kan vi ende opp med uopprettelige skader på miljøet.
example_english: If we do not act now, we may end up with irreparable damage to the environment.

english: the price to pay, the cost
example: Konstant jag etter suksess kan være prisen å betale for å forsømme relasjoner og helse.
example_english: A constant chase for success can be the price to pay for neglecting relationships and health.

english: the exact opposite, the very opposite
example: Det hun sa i intervjuet var det stikk motsatte av hva hun hadde lovet velgerne sine.
example_english: What she said in the interview was the exact opposite of what she had promised her voters.

english: to perform at one's best, to give maximum performance
example: Toppidrettsutøvere trener metodisk for å prestere maksimalt på de viktigste konkurransene.
example_english: Elite athletes train methodically to perform at their best at the most important competitions.

english: free rein, complete freedom to act
example: Sjefen ga det kreative teamet frie tøyler til å utvikle konseptet på sin egen måte.
example_english: The boss gave the creative team free rein to develop the concept in their own way.

english: to be named after
example: Biblioteket er oppkalt etter den kjente forfatteren som vokste opp i denne byen.
example_english: The library is named after the famous author who grew up in this city.

english: to set high standards, to demand a great deal
example: En god leder stiller høye krav til seg selv før han stiller dem til andre.
example_english: A good leader sets high standards for himself before setting them for others.

english: simply, just, plain and simple
example: Det er rett og slett ikke akseptabelt å behandle kolleger på en nedlatende måte.
example_english: It is simply not acceptable to treat colleagues in a condescending way.

english: to hang out with friends
example: I helgene liker hun best å henge med venner og slappe av uten noe spesielt program.
example_english: At weekends she most likes to hang out with friends and relax without any specific agenda.

english: it is a balancing act, it requires balance
example: Det er en konstant balansegang mellom å gi barna frihet og å beskytte dem fra fare.
example_english: It is a constant balancing act between giving children freedom and protecting them from harm.

english: to be motivated by, to be driven by
example: Hun blir motivert av utfordringer og gir alltid sitt beste når det virkelig teller.
example_english: She is motivated by challenges and always gives her best when it really counts.

english: to invest in, to bet on, to focus on
example: Regjeringen har bestemt seg for å satse på fornybar energi i de kommende årene.
example_english: The government has decided to invest in renewable energy in the coming years.

english: to stand out, to distinguish oneself
example: For å lykkes i et konkurransepreget marked må bedriften stikke seg ut fra mengden.
example_english: To succeed in a competitive market the company must stand out from the crowd.

english: to support, to back up, to rally behind
example: Det er viktig at skolesystemet støtter opp om elevenes individuelle behov og talenter.
example_english: It is important that the school system supports pupils' individual needs and talents.

english: to cheer on, to root for
example: Hele nabolaget stod langs veien og heiet på maratonløperne da de passerte.
example_english: The whole neighbourhood stood along the road cheering on the marathon runners as they passed.

english: in step with, in line with, keeping pace with
example: Lønningene har ikke økt i takt med de stadig stigende levekostnadene de siste årene.
example_english: Wages have not increased in step with the ever-rising cost of living in recent years.

english: to pay off, to be worth it
example: Det lønner seg alltid å investere tid i å lære seg nye ferdigheter i løpet av karrieren.
example_english: It always pays off to invest time in learning new skills throughout one's career.

english: to keep track of, to follow, to pay attention to
example: Det er krevende å følge med på alle endringene i regelverket innen denne bransjen.
example_english: It is demanding to keep track of all the regulatory changes in this industry.

english: in contrast to, unlike, as opposed to
example: I motsetning til søsteren sin foretrekker hun å jobbe alene fremfor i team.
example_english: In contrast to her sister, she prefers to work alone rather than in a team.

english: made for, perfectly suited to
example: Med sin tålmodighet og sitt engasjement er han som skapt for læreryrket.
example_english: With his patience and commitment he is made for the teaching profession.

english: to pick up speed, to accelerate, to gain momentum
example: Etter den første nølende fasen begynte prosjektet å skyte fart og levere resultater.
example_english: After the initial hesitant phase the project began to pick up speed and deliver results.

english: to get to the bottom of, to fully understand
example: Granskingskommisjonen ble nedsatt for å komme til bunns i årsaken til ulykken.
example_english: The inquiry commission was set up to get to the bottom of the cause of the accident.

english: to be put together, to be wired, to handle things well
example: Hun er godt skrudd sammen og takler press og kritikk med imponerende ro.
example_english: She is well put together and handles pressure and criticism with impressive composure.

english: to score high, to rank highly
example: Norge skårer høyt på internasjonale målinger av livskvalitet og innbyggernes tilfredshet.
example_english: Norway scores high on international measurements of quality of life and citizens' satisfaction.

english: to be expressed, to manifest, to find expression
example: Kulturforskjellene kan komme til uttrykk i ulike forventninger til arbeidsmiljøet.
example_english: Cultural differences can be expressed in different expectations about the work environment.

english: to take a stance on, to address, to decide about
example: Politikerne må til slutt ta stilling til de vanskelige etiske spørsmålene rundt teknologien.
example_english: Politicians must ultimately take a stance on the difficult ethical questions surrounding the technology.

english: to result in, to manifest as, to show up as
example: Økt stress over lengre tid kan gi utslag i søvnproblemer og konsentrasjonsvansker.
example_english: Increased stress over a longer period can result in sleep problems and concentration difficulties.

english: to spend time with
example: Studier viser at barn som tilbringer tid med foreldrene, trives bedre på skolen.
example_english: Studies show that children who spend time with their parents do better at school.

english: to get the opportunity to, to have the chance to
example: Alle ansatte bør få mulighet til faglig utvikling og kompetanseheving i løpet av karrieren.
example_english: All employees should get the opportunity for professional development and skills enhancement during their career.

english: to feel safe with, to feel comfortable with
example: Det er avgjørende at pasienter føler seg trygge med legen sin og kan snakke åpent.
example_english: It is crucial that patients feel safe with their doctor and can speak openly.

english: to be academically gifted, to be a bright student
example: Han var ikke akkurat et skolelys, men hans praktiske evner og kreativitet var enestående.
example_english: He was not exactly an academic star, but his practical skills and creativity were exceptional.

english: mediocre, average, run-of-the-mill
example: Resultatene var midt på treet – verken spesielt gode eller spesielt dårlige, bare middelmådige.
example_english: The results were mediocre – neither particularly good nor particularly bad, just average.

english: easier said than done
example: Å bryte dårlige vaner er lettere sagt enn gjort, og krever tålmodighet over tid.
example_english: Breaking bad habits is easier said than done and requires patience over time.

english: to be encouraged, to receive encouragement
example: Mange unge kunstnere trenger å bli oppmuntret av lærere og familie for å tørre å satse.
example_english: Many young artists need to be encouraged by teachers and family to dare to pursue their ambitions.

english: to give up, to quit
example: Gi aldri opp drømmene dine, selv om veien dit er lang og full av hindringer.
example_english: Never give up on your dreams, even if the road there is long and full of obstacles.

english: to hang together, to be connected, to make sense
example: Rapporten henger ikke helt sammen – argumentene er motstridende og konklusjonen er uklar.
example_english: The report does not quite hang together – the arguments are contradictory and the conclusion is unclear.

english: to gain self-confidence, to build confidence
example: Å mestre nye ferdigheter er en fin måte å få selvtillit på, uansett alder.
example_english: Mastering new skills is a great way to gain self-confidence, regardless of age.

english: to be disappointed
example: Publikum ble skuffet da konserten ble avlyst med bare noen timers varsel.
example_english: The audience was disappointed when the concert was cancelled with only a few hours' notice.

english: to have a lot on one's mind, to have much to say
example: Etter møtet var det tydelig at mange medarbeidere hadde mye på hjertet om arbeidsforholdene.
example_english: After the meeting it was clear that many employees had a lot on their minds about working conditions.

english: to be up to date, to be well-informed
example: Det er viktig å være oppdatert på de nyeste forskningsresultatene innen sitt fagfelt.
example_english: It is important to be up to date on the latest research findings within one's field.

norsk: å smile fra øre til øre
lemma: å smile fra øre til øre
english: to beam from ear to ear, to grin broadly
example: Da hun fikk vite at hun hadde bestått eksamen, smilte hun fra øre til øre av glede.
example_english: When she found out she had passed the exam, she beamed from ear to ear with joy.

english: to support oneself, to be self-sufficient
example: Etter endt utdanning ønsket han å forsørge seg selv og bli uavhengig av foreldrene.
example_english: After finishing his education he wanted to support himself and become independent of his parents.

english: it commands respect, it is admirable
example: Det står respekt av måten hun håndterte krisen på – rolig, besluttsom og rettferdig.
example_english: It commands respect the way she handled the crisis – calmly, decisively and fairly.

english: to rest on one's laurels, to be complacent after success
example: Etter den store seieren er det lett å hvile på laurbærene, men det er en farlig felle.
example_english: After the great victory it is easy to rest on one's laurels, but that is a dangerous trap.

english: to enjoy life, to savour one's existence
example: I pensjonstilværelsen har han endelig funnet tid til å nyte tilværelsen uten stress.
example_english: In retirement he has finally found time to enjoy life without stress.

norsk: å sette seg godt til rette
lemma: å sette seg godt til rette
english: to make oneself comfortable, to settle in
example: Gjestene satte seg godt til rette i de myke sofaene mens vertskapet forberedte maten.
example_english: The guests made themselves comfortable in the soft sofas while the hosts prepared the food.

english: to contribute to, to help bring about
example: Alle kan bidra til et bedre miljø gjennom bevisste valg i hverdagen.
example_english: Everyone can contribute to a better environment through conscious choices in daily life.

english: to address, to turn to, to contact
example: Dersom du har spørsmål, kan du henvende seg til resepsjonen i første etasje.
example_english: If you have questions, you can turn to the reception on the first floor.

english: it is urgent, there is no time to lose
example: Det haster å finne løsninger på klimakrisen før skadene blir irreversible.
example_english: It is urgent to find solutions to the climate crisis before the damage becomes irreversible.

english: to follow up, to follow through, to monitor
example: Ledelsen lovet å følge opp de ansattes bekymringer innen utgangen av måneden.
example_english: Management promised to follow up on employees' concerns by the end of the month.

english: to be informed about, to be aware of
example: Pasientene har rett til å være opplyst om alle behandlingsalternativene som finnes.
example_english: Patients have the right to be informed about all the treatment options available.

english: to be conscious of, to be mindful of
example: Det er viktig å være bevisst på hvilken effekt ordvalgene våre har på andre mennesker.
example_english: It is important to be conscious of the effect our choice of words has on other people.

english: as a result of, as a consequence of
example: Som følge av pandemien ble mange bedrifter tvunget til å omstille seg raskt og drastisk.
example_english: As a result of the pandemic many businesses were forced to adapt quickly and drastically.

english: to have an overview of, to have a grasp of
example: En god prosjektleder må alltid ha oversikt over alle oppgaver og tidsfrister.
example_english: A good project manager must always have an overview of all tasks and deadlines.

english: to sit loosely, to be uncertain, to be at risk
example: Etter den negative rapporten sitter sjefens stilling ganske løst i organisasjonen.
example_english: After the negative report the boss's position sits rather loosely within the organisation.

english: everything under the sun, every conceivable thing
example: De har prøvd alt mellom himmel og jord for å finne en løsning uten hell.
example_english: They have tried everything under the sun to find a solution without success.

english: to be capable of, to be able to
example: Med riktig trening og motivasjon er mennesket i stand til utrolige prestasjoner.
example_english: With proper training and motivation a person is capable of incredible achievements.

english: to hush something up, to suppress by silence
example: Myndighetene forsøkte å tie skandalen i hjel, men pressen avdekket sannheten.
example_english: The authorities tried to hush up the scandal, but the press uncovered the truth.

english: like, similarly to, in common with
example: I likhet med mange nordmenn tilbringer hun helst ferien i den norske naturen.
example_english: Like many Norwegians, she prefers to spend her holiday in Norwegian nature.

english: to be hit by, to be struck by, to be affected by
example: Hele regionen ble rammet av kraftige flommer etter de voldsomme nedbørsmengdene.
example_english: The entire region was hit by severe floods after the tremendous amounts of rainfall.

english: to shut down, to close down
example: Under pandemien ble restauranter og kulturarenaer beordret å stenge ned over natten.
example_english: During the pandemic restaurants and cultural venues were ordered to shut down overnight.

english: in peacetime, during times of peace
example: Ressursene som brukes på militæret i fredstid, kunne alternativt gå til skole og helse.
example_english: The resources spent on the military in peacetime could alternatively go to schools and health.

english: to be acclaimed for, to be praised for
example: Filmskaperen ble hyllet for sitt modige og originale blikk på norsk samtidshistorie.
example_english: The filmmaker was acclaimed for his courageous and original perspective on contemporary Norwegian history.

english: not necessarily
example: At noe er dyrt, betyr ikke nødvendigvis at det er av bedre kvalitet enn billige alternativer.
example_english: The fact that something is expensive does not necessarily mean it is of better quality than cheaper alternatives.

english: to be pleased about, to take pleasure in
example: Det er lett å glemme å glede seg over de små tingene i en travel hverdag.
example_english: It is easy to forget to take pleasure in the small things in a busy everyday life.

english: it is high time, it is about time
example: Det er på høy tid at politikerne tar ansvar og gjennomfører de nødvendige reformene.
example_english: It is high time that politicians took responsibility and implemented the necessary reforms.

english: to be in despair over, to be distraught about
example: Hun var fortvilet over nyheten om at sykdommen ikke kunne kureres med kjent behandling.
example_english: She was in despair over the news that the disease could not be cured with known treatment.

english: to pluck up courage, to summon one's courage
example: Han tok endelig mot til seg og ba om økt lønn etter tre år uten lønnsforhandlinger.
example_english: He finally plucked up courage and asked for a pay rise after three years without salary negotiations.

english: to put one's life on hold
example: Mange pårørende setter livet på vent for å pleie syke familiemedlemmer over lang tid.
example_english: Many carers put their lives on hold to care for sick family members over a long period.

english: to be preoccupied with, to care about, to be focused on
example: Hun er svært opptatt av bærekraft og stiller strenge krav til leverandørene sine.
example_english: She is very focused on sustainability and sets strict requirements for her suppliers.

english: with the help of, by means of
example: Ved hjelp av moderne teknologi kan legene nå stille diagnoser raskere og mer presist.
example_english: With the help of modern technology doctors can now make diagnoses more quickly and precisely.

english: there are divided opinions on, people disagree about
example: Det er delte meninger om hvorvidt arbeidstiden bør reduseres til fire dager i uken.
example_english: There are divided opinions on whether working hours should be reduced to four days a week.

english: to cheat one's way to, to obtain by cheating
example: Han jukset seg til karakterene og fikk etter hvert en jobb han ikke var kvalifisert for.
example_english: He cheated his way to his grades and eventually got a job he was not qualified for.

english: to bring about, to lead to, to entail
example: Digitalisering fører med seg mange fordeler, men også nye utfordringer for arbeidslivet.
example_english: Digitalisation brings about many advantages, but also new challenges for working life.

english: to be at risk of, to be in danger of
example: Arten står i fare for å utryddes dersom ikke habitatet beskyttes umiddelbart.
example_english: The species is at risk of extinction if its habitat is not protected immediately.

english: with the exception of, except for
example: Med unntak av ett enkelt land stemte hele FN-komiteen for resolusjonen.
example_english: With the exception of one single country, the entire UN committee voted for the resolution.

english: to be in employment, to be working
example: Det er et politisk mål at flest mulig skal stå i arbeid og bidra til fellesskapet.
example_english: It is a political goal that as many people as possible should be in employment and contribute to the community.

english: to contribute to the community, to give back to society
example: Frivillig arbeid er en fin måte å bidra til fellesskapet og møte nye mennesker på.
example_english: Voluntary work is a great way to contribute to the community and meet new people.

english: to be in the process of, to be about to
example: Selskapet er i ferd med å gjennomføre sin største restrukturering på over et tiår.
example_english: The company is in the process of carrying out its largest restructuring in over a decade.

english: to pay the price, to face the consequences
example: De som ignorerte advarslene, måtte til slutt betale prisen for sin likegyldighet.
example_english: Those who ignored the warnings ultimately had to pay the price for their indifference.

english: to have one's eyes opened, to realize
example: Reisen til fattige land fikk ham virkelig opp øynene for sine egne privilegier.
example_english: The trip to poor countries really opened his eyes to his own privileges.

english: a drop in the ocean, a negligible amount
example: Donasjonene var et godt tegn, men i forhold til behovet var de bare en dråpe i havet.
example_english: The donations were a good sign, but in relation to the need they were just a drop in the ocean.

norsk: det skal ikke så mye til
lemma: det skal ikke så mye til
english: it does not take much, a little goes a long way
example: Det skal ikke så mye til for å gjøre en stor forskjell i andres liv hver dag.
example_english: It does not take much to make a big difference in other people's lives every day.

english: to pull oneself together, to sharpen up
example: Treneren sa klart fra at spillerne måtte skjerpe seg dersom de ville beholde plassen.
example_english: The coach made it clear that the players needed to sharpen up if they wanted to keep their place.

english: to pull oneself together, to get a grip
example: Etter det tunge tapet bestemte hun seg for å ta seg sammen og fortsette kampen.
example_english: After the heavy defeat she decided to pull herself together and continue the fight.

english: to be prepared for, to be ready for, to expect
example: Du bør være innstilt på at prosessen kan ta lengre tid enn du opprinnelig hadde håpet.
example_english: You should be prepared for the process to take longer than you had originally hoped.

english: in the worst case, at worst
example: I verste fall kan de manglende sikkerhetstiltakene føre til alvorlige ulykker på anlegget.
example_english: In the worst case the missing safety measures could lead to serious accidents at the facility.

english: it provokes me that, it angers me that
example: Det provoserer meg at ressurssterke grupper konsekvent slipper unna med lovbrudd uten konsekvenser.
example_english: It angers me that resourceful groups consistently get away with breaking the law without consequences.

norsk: det spørs hvor dypt det stikker
lemma: det spørs hvor dypt det stikker
english: the question is how deep it cuts, how serious it really is
example: Han sa han ikke brydde seg om kritikken, men det spørs hvor dypt det egentlig stakk.
example_english: He said he did not care about the criticism, but the question is how deep it really cut.

english: when it comes down to it, when push comes to shove
example: Når det kommer til stykket, handler de fleste valg om å prioritere det som virkelig teller.
example_english: When it comes down to it, most choices are about prioritising what truly matters.

english: to follow someone's example, to emulate someone
example: Yngre politikere burde følge hennes eksempel og prioritere åpenhet og ærlighet.
example_english: Younger politicians should follow her example and prioritise transparency and honesty.

english: not to put up with, not to tolerate
example: Han nektet å finne seg i den urettferdige behandlingen og klaget saken inn for retten.
example_english: He refused to put up with the unfair treatment and brought the case to court.

english: to dedicate oneself to, to devote oneself to
example: Hun valgte å vie seg til forskning på sjeldne sykdommer og la karrieremulighetene vente.
example_english: She chose to dedicate herself to research on rare diseases and put career opportunities aside.

english: to attract attention, to cause a stir
example: Utstillingen vakte stor oppsikt med sine kontroversielle og politisk ladede kunstverk.
example_english: The exhibition caused a great stir with its controversial and politically charged artworks.

english: to be poorly informed, to be misinformed
example: Mange velger å stemme uten å sette seg inn i sakene og er dermed dårlig informert.
example_english: Many people choose to vote without studying the issues and are therefore poorly informed.

english: to play on emotions, to appeal to feelings
example: Reklamen spiller bevisst på følelser for å påvirke forbrukernes kjøpsbeslutninger.
example_english: The advertisement deliberately plays on emotions to influence consumers' purchasing decisions.

english: to generate engagement around something, to mobilise interest
example: Organisasjonen jobber hardt for å skape engasjement rundt klimasaken blant unge.
example_english: The organisation works hard to generate engagement around the climate issue among young people.

english: to be forced to, to have no choice but to
example: Vi er nødt til å gjøre drastiske endringer dersom vi ønsker å bevare planeten for fremtiden.
example_english: We are forced to make drastic changes if we want to preserve the planet for the future.

english: to earn, to deserve through effort
example: Hun hadde jobbet hardt i mange år og hadde virkelig gjort seg fortjent til prisen.
example_english: She had worked hard for many years and had truly earned the award.

english: to introduce measures, to implement measures
example: Kommunen valgte å innføre tiltak mot støy etter mange klager fra beboerne i området.
example_english: The municipality chose to introduce measures against noise following many complaints from residents in the area.

english: to take action, to take firm measures
example: Ledelsen måtte ta grep for å stoppe den eskalerende konflikten mellom avdelingene.
example_english: Management had to take action to stop the escalating conflict between the departments.

english: to switch to, to transition to
example: Stadig flere bedrifter velger å gå over til fornybare energikilder for å kutte utslipp.
example_english: More and more businesses are choosing to switch to renewable energy sources to cut emissions.

english: at the expense of
example: Mange steder prioriteres økonomisk vekst på bekostning av miljø og sosial rettferdighet.
example_english: In many places economic growth is prioritised at the expense of the environment and social justice.

english: to stand for, to represent, to vouch for
example: Partiet hevder å stå for likestilling, men handlingene deres forteller en annen historie.
example_english: The party claims to stand for equality, but their actions tell a different story.

english: to be of great importance to, to matter greatly for
example: Tidlig innsats i barnehagen har stor betydning for barns later sosiale og faglige utvikling.
example_english: Early intervention in kindergarten is of great importance for children's later social and academic development.

english: to shine a light on, to focus attention on
example: Rapporten retter søkelyset mot de alvorlige konsekvensene av sosial ulikhet i landet.
example_english: The report shines a light on the serious consequences of social inequality in the country.

english: a bit too much, on the excessive side
example: Prisen for inngangsbilletten var i overkant høy sammenlignet med hva arrangementet tilbød.
example_english: The price of the entry ticket was a bit too high compared to what the event offered.

english: on a large scale, at great scale
example: Solenergi produseres nå i stor skala og konkurrerer prismessig med fossile energikilder.
example_english: Solar energy is now produced on a large scale and competes on price with fossil energy sources.

english: to have the potential to, to have what it takes
example: Teknologien har potensial til å revolusjonere måten vi behandler kroniske sykdommer på.
example_english: The technology has the potential to revolutionise the way we treat chronic diseases.

english: to start from scratch, to start from zero
example: Etter brannen mistet de alt og måtte starte helt på null med ingenting i bakhånd.
example_english: After the fire they lost everything and had to start completely from scratch with nothing in reserve.

english: time after time, again and again
example: Gang etter gang har hun bevist at hun er den mest pålitelige personen i teamet.
example_english: Time after time she has proved that she is the most reliable person in the team.

english: once again, yet again
example: Nok en gang skuffet myndighetene innbyggerne ved å utsette de lovede forbedringene.
example_english: Once again the authorities disappointed the citizens by postponing the promised improvements.

english: to be driven by, to be governed by, to be ruled by
example: For mange blir beslutninger styrt av frykt fremfor rasjonell vurdering av situasjonen.
example_english: For many people decisions are driven by fear rather than a rational assessment of the situation.

english: to have the right to, to be entitled to
example: Alle arbeidstakere har rett til et trygt og helsefremmende arbeidsmiljø per norsk lov.
example_english: All employees have the right to a safe and health-promoting work environment under Norwegian law.

english: regardless of, independent of, irrespective of
example: Alle innbyggere skal behandles likt, uavhengig av bakgrunn, kjønn eller sosial status.
example_english: All citizens shall be treated equally, regardless of background, gender or social status.

english: to emphasise, to place importance on
example: I ansettelsesprosessen la selskapet stor vekt på søkernes kommunikasjonsevner og teamånd.
example_english: In the hiring process the company placed great importance on applicants' communication skills and team spirit.

english: considering, with regard to, given
example: Med tanke på alle utfordringene vi har møtt, er resultatet faktisk ganske imponerende.
example_english: Considering all the challenges we have faced, the result is actually quite impressive.

english: to give access to, to provide access to
example: Biblioteket gir gratis tilgang til tusenvis av e-bøker og digitale ressurser for alle.
example_english: The library gives free access to thousands of e-books and digital resources for everyone.

english: to be in demand, to be sought after
example: Fagfolk med kompetanse innen kunstig intelligens er svært etterspurt på arbeidsmarkedet.
example_english: Professionals with expertise in artificial intelligence are highly in demand on the job market.

english: to be aimed at, to be directed at
example: Kampanjen er rettet mot unge voksne mellom atten og tjuefem år i hele landet.
example_english: The campaign is aimed at young adults between eighteen and twenty-five across the whole country.

english: in addition to, as well as
example: I tillegg til norsk snakker hun flytende engelsk, spansk og mandarin.
example_english: In addition to Norwegian she speaks fluent English, Spanish and Mandarin.

english: to make one's own, to adapt to one's own style
example: Hun tok den klassiske melodien og gjorde den til sin helt egen med ny tekst og rytme.
example_english: She took the classic melody and made it entirely her own with new lyrics and rhythm.

english: to benefit from, to gain from
example: Elevene har stort utbytte av undervisningsformer som fremmer aktiv deltakelse og refleksjon.
example_english: Pupils gain greatly from teaching methods that promote active participation and reflection.

english: to be expelled, to be sent off, to be deported
example: Spilleren ble utvist etter en rå takling og måtte se resten av kampen fra tribunen.
example_english: The player was sent off after a brutal tackle and had to watch the rest of the match from the stands.

english: to put into use, to adopt, to start using
example: Sykehuset var tidlig ute med å ta i bruk robotteknologi i operasjonssalen.
example_english: The hospital was an early adopter of robotic technology in the operating theatre.

english: assessment for learning, formative assessment
example: Vurdering for læring handler om å gi tilbakemeldinger som hjelper elevene til å utvikle seg.
example_english: Assessment for learning is about giving feedback that helps pupils to develop.

english: to become aware of, to grow conscious of
example: Kurset hjalp deltakerne til å bli bevisste på egne kommunikasjonsmønstre og blindsoner.
example_english: The course helped participants to become aware of their own communication patterns and blind spots.

english: mainly, primarily, for the most part
example: Boken handler i hovedsak om de psykologiske ettervirkningene av langvarig isolasjon.
example_english: The book deals mainly with the psychological after-effects of prolonged isolation.

english: to straighten up, to stand tall, to assert oneself
example: Det er på tide å rette seg i ryggen og si tydelig fra om hva man mener og ønsker.
example_english: It is time to stand tall and say clearly what one thinks and wants.

english: you'd better watch out, woe betide you
example: Nåde dere hvis dere ikke har gjort leksene til i morgen, sa læreren med et strengt blikk.
example_english: You had better watch out if you have not done your homework by tomorrow, the teacher said with a stern look.

english: to keep quiet, to shut up
example: Han ble bedt om å holde kjeft under møtet, noe han opplevde som svært nedverdigende.
example_english: He was told to keep quiet during the meeting, which he found extremely demeaning.

english: to make sense of, to understand, to get one's head around
example: Jeg klarer ikke å begripe meg på hvordan noen kan behandle andre mennesker på den måten.
example_english: I cannot make sense of how anyone can treat other people in that way.

norsk: å ta seg selv i å si noe
lemma: å ta seg selv i å si noe
english: to catch oneself saying something
example: Hun tok seg selv i å si noe diskriminerende og ble svært flau over det.
example_english: She caught herself saying something discriminatory and was very embarrassed about it.

norsk: å snakke ned noe eller noen
lemma: å snakke ned noe eller noen
english: to talk down something or someone, to belittle, to disparage
example: Det er uproduktivt å snakke ned andres ideer uten å komme med konstruktive alternativer.
example_english: It is counterproductive to talk down others' ideas without offering constructive alternatives.

english: to make a difference
example: Selv små tiltak kan utgjøre en stor forskjell for sårbare grupper i samfunnet.
example_english: Even small measures can make a big difference for vulnerable groups in society.

english: good grief, damn it, blimey
example: Søren meg, jeg glemte å betale regningen igjen – nå får jeg sikkert et gebyr.
example_english: Good grief, I forgot to pay the bill again – now I will probably get a fine.

english: to put down, to run down, to badmouth
example: Det er urettferdig å rakke ned på folk bak ryggen i stedet for å ta det opp direkte.
example_english: It is unfair to put people down behind their backs instead of raising it directly.

english: a know-it-all with half-knowledge, a self-taught amateur
example: Ikke lytt til den halvstuderte røveren – søk heller råd hos en kvalifisert spesialist.
example_english: Do not listen to that half-baked know-it-all – seek advice from a qualified specialist instead.

english: to cut deep, to sting, to hurt deeply
example: Ordene hennes stakk dypt og han tenkte på dem lenge etter at samtalen var over.
example_english: Her words cut deep and he thought about them long after the conversation was over.

english: to get tunnel vision, to become narrow-minded
example: Under press kan ledere få tunnelsyn og overse viktige signaler fra omgivelsene.
example_english: Under pressure leaders can get tunnel vision and overlook important signals from their surroundings.

norsk: å bli en del av noe
lemma: å bli en del av noe
english: to become part of something, to be included
example: Det tok tid, men til slutt ble hun en naturlig del av det sosiale miljøet på jobben.
example_english: It took time, but eventually she became a natural part of the social environment at work.

english: a learning curve
example: Det er en bratt læringskurve å starte i ny jobb, men det blir lettere etter hvert.
example_english: Starting a new job involves a steep learning curve, but it gets easier over time.

english: at short notice, at short order
example: Teamet klarte å levere et imponerende resultat på svært kort varsel.
example_english: The team managed to deliver an impressive result at very short notice.

english: in other words, that is to say
example: Budsjettet ble ikke godkjent – med andre ord må vi finne rimeligere løsninger.
example_english: The budget was not approved – in other words we need to find cheaper solutions.

english: to do something meaningful, to do something worthwhile
example: Hun byttet ut den høytlønnede jobben for å gjøre noe mer meningsfylt for samfunnet.
example_english: She swapped the high-paying job to do something more meaningful for society.

english: to contribute to society
example: Frivilligarbeid er en konkret måte å bidra til samfunnet og møte andre engasjerte mennesker.
example_english: Voluntary work is a concrete way to contribute to society and meet other committed people.

english: at regular intervals, periodically
example: Med jevne mellomrom evalueres alle ansatte, slik at eventuelle problemer kan tas opp tidlig.
example_english: At regular intervals all employees are evaluated so that any problems can be raised early.

english: that would be something, wouldn't that be something
example: En uke uten e-post og møter – det hadde virkelig vært noe, det!
example_english: A week without emails and meetings – that really would be something!

english: you're telling me, you can say that again, you've got a point
example: "Det er dyrt å bo i Oslo." – "Du sier noe. Jeg bruker halvparten av lønnen på leie."
example_english: "It is expensive to live in Oslo." – "You're telling me. I spend half my wage on rent."

english: to slip up, to go off track, to lose focus
example: Etter noen måneder begynte treningsrutinen hans å skli ut og han trente stadig sjeldnere.
example_english: After a few months his training routine began to slip and he trained less and less frequently.

english: I bet that, I would wager that
example: Jeg skal vedde på at de aldri hadde tenkt på den løsningen uten innspill fra de unge.
example_english: I bet they would never have thought of that solution without input from the young people.

english: one is allowed to dream, it is fine to dream
example: Jeg vet det er urealistisk, men det er lov å drømme om å vinne i Lotto.
example_english: I know it is unrealistic, but one is allowed to dream about winning the lottery.

english: to offer, to volunteer
example: Hun tilbød seg å ta ansvar for prosjektet da ingen andre meldte sin interesse.
example_english: She offered to take responsibility for the project when nobody else expressed an interest.

english: it turned out that, it emerged that
example: Det viste seg at feilen kom fra en enkelt linje med kode skrevet for ti år siden.
example_english: It turned out that the error came from a single line of code written ten years ago.

english: social dumping, undercutting wages and conditions
example: Fagforeningene krever strengere regler for å hindre sosial dumping innen byggebransjen.
example_english: The trade unions demand stricter rules to prevent social dumping in the construction industry.

english: this means that, this implies that
example: Det innebærer at alle ansatte må gjennomgå obligatorisk opplæring i datasikkerhet.
example_english: This means that all employees must complete mandatory training in data security.

norsk: å sette noe ut på anbud
lemma: å sette noe ut på anbud
english: to put something out to tender
example: Kommunen valgte å sette vedlikeholdsarbeidet ut på anbud for å spare penger.
example_english: The municipality chose to put the maintenance work out to tender in order to save money.

norsk: Det er god grunn til å
lemma: Det er god grunn til å
english: there is good reason to, there are solid grounds for
example: Det er god grunn til å tro at de nye tiltakene vil ha en positiv effekt på folkehelsen.
example_english: There is good reason to believe that the new measures will have a positive effect on public health.

english: to accept, to say yes to
example: Etter lang betenkningstid valgte hun å takke ja til tilbudet og flytte til Oslo.
example_english: After lengthy consideration she chose to accept the offer and move to Oslo.

english: to put into words, to articulate
example: Det er vanskelig å sette ord på den følelsen av lettelse du kjenner etter en krevende periode.
example_english: It is difficult to put into words the feeling of relief you sense after a demanding period.

english: to go badly wrong, to go off the rails
example: Dersom ledelsen ikke griper inn snart, kan hele prosjektet bære galt av sted.
example_english: If management does not intervene soon, the entire project could go badly wrong.

english: to do the rounds, to circulate, to go around
example: Etter valget gikk ryktene på rundgang om hvem som ville bli utnevnt til statsråder.
example_english: After the election rumours were doing the rounds about who would be appointed ministers.

norsk: å være forberedt på å gjøre noe
lemma: å være forberedt på å gjøre noe
english: to be prepared to do something
example: En god leder må alltid være forberedt på å ta vanskelige beslutninger under press.
example_english: A good leader must always be prepared to make difficult decisions under pressure.

english: one might think that, you would perhaps suppose that
example: Man skulle kanskje tro at mer penger alltid gir mer lykke, men forskning viser noe annet.
example_english: One might think that more money always brings more happiness, but research suggests otherwise.

english: to have use for, to need
example: I fremtiden vil alle ha bruk for grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter i arbeidslivet.
example_english: In the future everyone will need basic digital skills in working life.

english: to have knowledge of, to be familiar with
example: Det er en fordel å ha kjennskap til lokale skikker og tradisjoner når man bor i utlandet.
example_english: It is an advantage to be familiar with local customs and traditions when living abroad.

english: to leave something to someone, to hand over to
example: Hun bestemte seg for å overlate det daglige ansvaret til nestlederen og fokusere på strategi.
example_english: She decided to leave the daily responsibility to the deputy and focus on strategy.

english: nothing to aspire to, nothing to strive for
example: En karriere uten mening eller personlig vekst er ikke noe å hige etter.
example_english: A career without meaning or personal growth is nothing to aspire to.

english: to have no chance of getting, to kiss goodbye to
example: Uten bedre infrastruktur kan distriktet se langt etter tilflyttere og nye bedrifter.
example_english: Without better infrastructure the district can kiss goodbye to new residents and businesses.

english: to make do with, to settle for
example: Da de beste alternativene var utsolgt, måtte de ta til takke med det som var igjen.
example_english: When the best options were sold out, they had to make do with what was left.

english: at the bottom of the hierarchy, at the lowest rung
example: I mange land befinner kvinner seg fortsatt nederst på rangstigen i næringsliv og politikk.
example_english: In many countries women still find themselves at the bottom of the hierarchy in business and politics.

english: all credit to, full credit to
example: All ære til de frivillige som jobbet dag og natt for å redde dyrene etter flommen.
example_english: All credit to the volunteers who worked day and night to rescue the animals after the flood.

norsk: å få samfunnet til å gå rundt
lemma: å få samfunnet til å gå rundt
english: to keep society running, to make society function
example: Det er de vanlige menneskene i hverdagsyrkene som virkelig får samfunnet til å gå rundt.
example_english: It is ordinary people in everyday jobs who really keep society running.

norsk: å jobbe seg opp fra gulvet
lemma: å jobbe seg opp fra gulvet
english: to work one's way up from nothing, to start from the bottom
example: Han har jobbet seg opp fra gulvet og bygget en suksessrik bedrift gjennom hardt arbeid.
example_english: He has worked his way up from nothing and built a successful business through hard work.

english: to accidentally end up doing, to do by mistake
example: Han kom i skade for å si noe upassende og måtte be om unnskyldning etterpå.
example_english: He accidentally ended up saying something inappropriate and had to apologise afterwards.

english: to talk something down, to dismiss, to belittle
example: Det er ikke konstruktivt å snakke ned andres forslag uten å presentere egne alternativer.
example_english: It is not constructive to talk down others' proposals without presenting your own alternatives.

english: to be caught off guard, to be taken by surprise
example: Lederne ble tatt på senga av den brå krisen og hadde ingen beredskapsplan.
example_english: The leaders were caught off guard by the sudden crisis and had no contingency plan.

english: criss-cross, in all directions, all over the place
example: Journalisten reiste på kryss og tvers i landet for å samle historier til reportasjen.
example_english: The journalist travelled criss-cross across the country to collect stories for the feature.

english: to hit the nail on the head
example: Kommentaren hennes traff spikeren på hodet og oppsummerte problemstillingen perfekt.
example_english: Her comment hit the nail on the head and summarised the issue perfectly.

english: to circle around, to beat around the bush
example: Slutt å sirkle rundt problemet og si rett ut hva du mener er den beste løsningen.
example_english: Stop circling around the problem and say straight out what you think the best solution is.

english: time will tell, we shall see, only time will tell
example: Om det nye systemet faktisk fungerer bedre? Den som lever, får se.
example_english: Whether the new system will actually work better? Time will tell.

english: to keep society running, to keep things functioning
example: Helsepersonell og lærere er blant de som holder samfunnet i gang i krevende tider.
example_english: Healthcare workers and teachers are among those who keep society running in demanding times.

english: to have a feeling of, to have a sense of
example: Mange innvandrere har en følelse av å stå med ett ben i to ulike kulturer.
example_english: Many immigrants have a feeling of standing with one foot in two different cultures.

english: to have access to
example: Ikke alle elever har tilgang til de digitale verktøyene som trengs i moderne undervisning.
example_english: Not all pupils have access to the digital tools needed in modern teaching.

english: to base something on, to found something on
example: Beslutningen bør baseres på solid forskning, ikke på magefølelse og politisk press.
example_english: The decision should be based on solid research, not on gut feeling and political pressure.

english: to be completely deceived, to be taken for a complete ride
example: Hun innså for sent at hun hadde blitt lurt trill rundt av den karismatiske svindleren.
example_english: She realised too late that she had been completely taken for a ride by the charismatic fraudster.

english: to pose as, to pretend to be, to pass oneself off as
example: Han ga seg ut for å være lege og lurte til seg sensitive pasientopplysninger.
example_english: He posed as a doctor and tricked his way to sensitive patient information.

english: to prepare someone for something, to equip someone for
example: Skolens oppgave er å ruste elevene for et arbeidsliv og samfunn i rask endring.
example_english: The school's task is to equip pupils for a working life and society undergoing rapid change.

english: to a greater extent, more so
example: Fremtidens yrkesliv vil i større grad kreve evne til kontinuerlig læring og omstilling.
example_english: The working life of the future will to a greater extent require the ability to learn and adapt continuously.

english: to follow the news, to keep up with current events
example: Det er en demokratisk plikt å følge med i nyhetsbildet og holde seg informert.
example_english: It is a democratic duty to follow the news and keep oneself informed.

english: to orientate oneself, to find one's bearings
example: Det tok tid å orientere seg i det nye landet, men gradvis ble livet enklere.
example_english: It took time to find one's bearings in the new country, but gradually life became easier.

english: virtually everyone, almost all
example: Tilnærmet alle barn i Norge har i dag tilgang til barnehage, uavhengig av økonomi.
example_english: Virtually all children in Norway today have access to kindergarten, regardless of finances.

english: in connection with, in relation to
example: I forbindelse med jubileet arrangeres det konserter og utstillinger i hele byen.
example_english: In connection with the anniversary, concerts and exhibitions are being arranged throughout the city.

english: to never doubt, to have complete conviction
example: Hun aldri tvilte på at rettferdigheten til slutt ville seire i rettssalen.
example_english: She never doubted that justice would ultimately prevail in the courtroom.

english: myth or fact, joke or reality
example: Fleip eller fakta: Er det sant at vi bare bruker ti prosent av hjernens kapasitet?
example_english: Myth or fact: Is it true that we only use ten per cent of the brain's capacity?

english: to take something seriously
example: Det er avgjørende at myndighetene tar tegn på mental helse-krise blant unge på alvor.
example_english: It is crucial that the authorities take signs of mental health crisis among young people seriously.

english: to get a word in, to be given a chance to speak
example: I store møter er det lett at stille stemmer aldri får komme til orde.
example_english: In large meetings it is easy for quiet voices never to get a chance to speak.

english: to send signals, to communicate intentions
example: Sentralbanken sender tydelige signaler om at rentene ikke vil senkes før neste år.
example_english: The central bank is sending clear signals that interest rates will not be lowered before next year.

english: to comment publicly, to make a public statement
example: Legen nektet å uttale seg offentlig om saken av hensyn til pasientens personvern.
example_english: The doctor refused to comment publicly on the case out of consideration for the patient's privacy.

english: to suffer under, to be harmed by
example: Mange arbeidere lider under dårlige arbeidsforhold som myndighetene er klar over.
example_english: Many workers suffer under poor working conditions that the authorities are aware of.

english: to be exposed to, to be subjected to, to be subjected to
example: Ansatte som blir utsatt for mobbing på arbeidsplassen, har rett til støtte og beskyttelse.
example_english: Employees who are subjected to bullying in the workplace have the right to support and protection.

english: to be encouraged to, to be urged to
example: Innbyggerne ble oppfordret til å redusere strømforbruket i perioden med kaldt vær.
example_english: Residents were urged to reduce electricity consumption during the period of cold weather.

english: to get the impression of, to gather that
example: Fra samtalen fikk jeg inntrykk av at han ikke var fornøyd med avtalen som var inngått.
example_english: From the conversation I got the impression that he was not happy with the agreement that had been made.

english: to hit right in the heart, to touch deeply
example: Sangens tekst traff rett i hjertet og fikk mange i salen til å begynne å gråte.
example_english: The song's lyrics hit right in the heart and made many people in the hall begin to cry.

english: in their own eyes, from their own perspective
example: I deres egne øyne handlet de alltid rettferdig, selv om andre opplevde det annerledes.
example_english: In their own eyes they always acted justly, even though others experienced it differently.

english: at one's best, at its finest
example: Denne forestillingen viser teateret på sitt beste – modig, originalt og dypt rørende.
example_english: This production shows the theatre at its finest – courageous, original and deeply moving.

english: to take for granted
example: Vi tar demokratiet for gitt, men det krever aktive borgere for å fungere godt.
example_english: We take democracy for granted, but it requires active citizens to function well.

english: to manage to, to succeed in, to pull off
example: Mot alle odds klarte de å få til en fredelig løsning på den langvarige konflikten.
example_english: Against all odds they managed to pull off a peaceful resolution to the long-standing conflict.

english: on behalf of
example: Direktøren takket på vegne av hele organisasjonen for det hardt arbeidet alle hadde lagt ned.
example_english: The director expressed thanks on behalf of the entire organisation for the hard work everyone had put in.

english: to care about, to be concerned about
example: Ledere som genuint bryr seg om de ansatte, skaper sterkere og mer lojale team.
example_english: Leaders who genuinely care about their employees create stronger and more loyal teams.

english: to withdraw, to pull away, to distance oneself
example: Etter bruddet trakk han seg unna vennene og holdt seg for det meste for seg selv.
example_english: After the break-up he withdrew from his friends and kept mostly to himself.

english: by comparison, for comparison
example: Norge bruker svært lite på militæret; til sammenligning bruker USA en langt høyere andel.
example_english: Norway spends very little on the military; by comparison, the US spends a far higher proportion.

english: to test out, to try out, to pilot
example: Kommunen ønsker å prøve ut en ny modell for eldreomsorg i to bydeler i første omgang.
example_english: The municipality wants to try out a new model for elderly care in two districts initially.

english: to hold to account, to call to account
example: Pressen har en viktig oppgave i å stille politikere og maktpersoner til ansvar.
example_english: The press has an important role in holding politicians and people in power to account.

english: to encourage, to cheer forward, to support actively
example: Lærere som heier fram alle elever, uansett ferdighetsnivå, gjør en uvurderlig innsats.
example_english: Teachers who actively encourage all pupils regardless of skill level make an invaluable contribution.

english: to make a difference
example: Du trenger ikke være berømt for å gjøre en ekte forskjell i andres liv.
example_english: You do not need to be famous to make a real difference in other people's lives.

english: significantly, enough to make a real difference
example: For å endre situasjonen må investeringene økes, og det monner.
example_english: To change the situation the investments must increase significantly and to a meaningful degree.

english: to phase out, to gradually eliminate
example: Regjeringen planlegger å fase ut alle bensinbiler innen utgangen av dette tiåret.
example_english: The government plans to phase out all petrol cars by the end of this decade.

english: to put a stop to, to halt
example: Myndighetene satte endelig en stopper for den ulovlige dumping av giftig avfall i elva.
example_english: The authorities finally put a stop to the illegal dumping of toxic waste in the river.

english: to benefit someone, to be of benefit to
example: De ekstra midlene til helse vil komme særlig dem med kroniske lidelser til gode.
example_english: The extra funds for health will particularly benefit those with chronic conditions.

english: to consist in, to be about, to involve
example: Jobben hans går i hovedsak ut på å koordinere samarbeid mellom ulike offentlige etater.
example_english: His job mainly consists in coordinating cooperation between various public agencies.

english: to have confidence in, to trust
example: For at systemet skal fungere, må innbyggerne ha tiltro til de demokratiske institusjonene.
example_english: For the system to function citizens must have confidence in the democratic institutions.

english: to be charged with, to be a suspect in
example: Den mistenkte ble siktet for grov korrupsjon etter en lang etterforskning.
example_english: The suspect was charged with serious corruption following a lengthy investigation.

english: to bring charges against, to prosecute
example: Påtalemyndigheten besluttet å reise tiltale mot selskapet for grove brudd på arbeidsmiljøloven.
example_english: The prosecution decided to bring charges against the company for serious violations of the working environment act.

english: to convince of, to persuade of
example: Det var vanskelig å overbevise styret om at den risikable investeringen var nødvendig.
example_english: It was difficult to convince the board that the risky investment was necessary.

english: to have the last word, to have the final say
example: I denne familien er det alltid bestemoren som har det siste ordet ved viktige avgjørelser.
example_english: In this family it is always the grandmother who has the last word on important decisions.

english: to decide whether, to determine whether
example: Juryen vil avgjøre om tiltalte er skyldig etter å ha vurdert all fremlagt bevisføring.
example_english: The jury will decide whether the defendant is guilty after considering all the evidence presented.

english: to arrive at, to reach, to come to
example: Etter lange forhandlinger klarte partene endelig å komme fram til en felles løsning.
example_english: After lengthy negotiations the parties finally managed to arrive at a common solution.

english: to be sentenced to, to be convicted to
example: Han ble dømt til fire års fengsel for svindel med offentlige midler.
example_english: He was sentenced to four years in prison for fraud involving public funds.

english: to send a signal about, to signal
example: Avgjørelsen sender et tydelig signal om at lovbrudd ikke vil bli tolerert.
example_english: The decision sends a clear signal that violations of the law will not be tolerated.

english: to have a criminal record
example: Søkeren hadde rulleblad, noe som kompliserte ansettelsesprosessen betraktelig.
example_english: The applicant had a criminal record, which considerably complicated the hiring process.

english: to be released on parole
example: Etter to år ble han løslatt på prøve under forutsetning av at han fulgte opp behandlingen.
example_english: After two years he was released on parole on condition that he continued with treatment.

english: to deduct, to subtract, to withdraw
example: Skatten trekkes automatisk fra lønnen din hvert år, så du slipper å tenke på det.
example_english: Tax is automatically deducted from your salary each year, so you do not need to think about it.

english: to attract attention, to draw notice
example: Kunstverket vakte oppmerksomhet internasjonalt og ble omtalt i ledende kunsttidsskrifter.
example_english: The artwork attracted international attention and was covered in leading art journals.

english: to be required, to be obliged, to be mandated
example: Alle arbeidsgivere er pålagt å tilby HMS-opplæring til nyansatte innen de første månedene.
example_english: All employers are required to provide health and safety training to new employees within the first months.

english: to get one's life in order, to sort one's life out
example: Etter en turbulent periode bestemte han seg for endelig å få skikk på livet.
example_english: After a turbulent period he decided to finally get his life in order.

english: to serve time in prison, to be locked up
example: Han satt inne i tre år og brukte tiden til å ta utdanning og reflektere over livet.
example_english: He served three years in prison and used the time to get an education and reflect on his life.

english: for life, life-long
example: Han ble idømt fengsel på livstid for de grove forbrytelsene han hadde begått.
example_english: He was sentenced to life in prison for the serious crimes he had committed.

english: to get away with, to escape, to evade
example: Lenge klarte han å slippe unna med juks, men etter hvert ble han avslørt.
example_english: For a long time he managed to get away with cheating, but eventually he was exposed.

english: to be on speaking terms with, to barely know
example: Vi er bare på hils med naboen; vi har aldri hatt en ordentlig samtale.
example_english: We are only on nodding terms with the neighbour; we have never had a proper conversation.

english: to be marked by, to be characterised by
example: Oppveksten hans var preget av fattigdom og usikkerhet, men han klarte seg godt.
example_english: His upbringing was marked by poverty and insecurity, but he managed well.

english: to play on fear, to exploit fear
example: Populistiske politikere spiller bevisst på frykt for å mobilisere velgerne sine.
example_english: Populist politicians deliberately play on fear to mobilise their voters.

english: to bear in mind, to keep in the back of one's mind
example: Det er greit å ha i bakhodet at planene kan endre seg etter hvert som situasjonen utvikler seg.
example_english: It is fine to bear in mind that plans may change as the situation develops.

english: to gain a foothold, to get established
example: Det tok tid for det nye partiet å få fotfeste i politikken, men nå vokser det raskt.
example_english: It took time for the new party to gain a foothold in politics, but now it is growing quickly.

english: to relate to, to identify with
example: Mange unge klarer ikke å relatere til politikerne og føler seg ikke representert.
example_english: Many young people are unable to relate to politicians and do not feel represented.

english: to result in, to lead to
example: Mangel på søvn over tid kan resultere i alvorlige helseproblemer og redusert livskvalitet.
example_english: Lack of sleep over time can result in serious health problems and reduced quality of life.

english: constantly, all the time, repeatedly
example: Han gjør stadig vekk de samme feilene, til tross for at han har blitt advart mange ganger.
example_english: He constantly makes the same mistakes, despite having been warned many times.

english: to be involved in
example: Etterforskningen avdekket at han hadde vært involvert i korrupsjon i mange år.
example_english: The investigation revealed that he had been involved in corruption for many years.

english: in principle, theoretically
example: I prinsippet er alle like for loven, men i praksis er det ikke alltid tilfelle.
example_english: In principle everyone is equal before the law, but in practice that is not always the case.

english: for its time, ahead of its time
example: Arkitekturen var revolusjonerende for sin tid og inspirerte en hel generasjon arkitekter.
example_english: The architecture was revolutionary for its time and inspired an entire generation of architects.

english: to have a lot in common
example: Til tross for ulik bakgrunn viste det seg at de hadde utrolig mye til felles.
example_english: Despite different backgrounds it turned out that they had an incredible amount in common.

english: to distance oneself from, to dissociate from
example: Partilederen var rask til å markere avstand til den kontroversielle uttalelsen.
example_english: The party leader was quick to distance himself from the controversial statement.

english: to portray something/someone as, to present as
example: Mediene framstilte henne som en helt, men sannheten var langt mer sammensatt.
example_english: The media portrayed her as a hero, but the truth was far more nuanced.

english: in the aftermath of, following
example: I etterkant av skandalen valgte direktøren å trekke seg fra stillingen sin.
example_english: In the aftermath of the scandal the director chose to step down from his position.

english: to make an effort, to put in effort
example: Alle som gjør en innsats for fellesskapet, fortjener anerkjennelse for bidraget sitt.
example_english: Everyone who makes an effort for the community deserves recognition for their contribution.

norsk: å være en stemme for de svakeste
lemma: å være en stemme for de svakeste
english: to be a voice for the most vulnerable
example: Organisasjonen har i mange år vært en viktig stemme for de svakeste i samfunnet.
example_english: The organisation has for many years been an important voice for the most vulnerable in society.

english: to intervene, to step in
example: Politiet ble tvunget til å gripe inn da demonstrasjonen eskalerte til vold.
example_english: The police were forced to intervene when the demonstration escalated into violence.

english: to make available, to put at the disposal of
example: Kommunen stilte lokaler til rådighet for flyktningene som kom til landet.
example_english: The municipality made premises available for the refugees who arrived in the country.

english: to create a counterweight to, to provide a counterbalance
example: Uavhengige medier er avgjørende for å skape en motvekt til statlig propaganda.
example_english: Independent media are crucial for creating a counterweight to state propaganda.

english: to be committed to, to be obligated to
example: Som signatar er landet forpliktet til å overholde avtalens krav og frister.
example_english: As a signatory the country is committed to complying with the agreement's requirements and deadlines.

english: to make available, to place at someone's disposal
example: Bedriften stilte biler til disposisjon for de ansatte under det store prosjektet.
example_english: The company placed cars at the disposal of employees during the major project.

english: organised by, under the auspices of, run by
example: Konferansen ble arrangert i regi av universitetet og samlet eksperter fra hele verden.
example_english: The conference was organised by the university and brought together experts from around the world.

english: to be a pillar of support, to be a supporter
example: Moren hans var alltid en støttespiller som ga ham mot til å forfølge drømmene.
example_english: His mother was always a pillar of support who gave him the courage to pursue his dreams.

english: initially, in principle, from the outset
example: I utgangspunktet var planen å fullføre prosjektet innen seks måneder.
example_english: Initially the plan was to complete the project within six months.

english: to go against the current, to swim against the tide
example: Det krever mot å gå mot strømmen og utfordre etablerte normer i samfunnet.
example_english: It takes courage to swim against the tide and challenge established norms in society.

english: to become isolated, to be cut off
example: Under pandemien ble mange eldre isolert fra familie og venner over lang tid.
example_english: During the pandemic many elderly people became isolated from family and friends for a long time.

english: to take one's time, to not rush
example: Kvalitetsarbeid tar sin tid, og det er bedre å levere sent enn å levere noe halvferdig.
example_english: Quality work takes its time, and it is better to deliver late than to deliver something half-finished.

english: to put something at risk, to jeopardise
example: Korrupsjonen truet med å sette hele fredsavtalen i fare på et kritisk tidspunkt.
example_english: The corruption threatened to put the entire peace agreement at risk at a critical moment.

english: to trail behind, to tag along, to follow blindly
example: Det er ikke tillitsvekkende for et land å bare dilte etter andres beslutninger.
example_english: It is not credible for a country to simply trail behind the decisions of others.

english: in the highest degree, extremely, most certainly
example: Spørsmålet om rettferdighet er i høyeste grad relevant i dagens politiske debatt.
example_english: The question of justice is extremely relevant in today's political debate.

english: to have the capacity to, to have the resources for
example: Helsevesenet har ikke kapasitet til å håndtere en ny stor pandemi uten ekstra ressurser.
example_english: The health service does not have the capacity to handle a new major pandemic without extra resources.

norsk: å kaste penger ut av vinduet
lemma: å kaste penger ut av vinduet
english: to throw money out of the window, to waste money
example: Å investere i dårlig planlagte prosjekter er å kaste penger ut av vinduet.
example_english: Investing in poorly planned projects is like throwing money out of the window.

norsk: å gå rett i lomma på
lemma: å gå rett i lomma på
english: to go straight into the pocket of, to benefit financially
example: Subsidiene gikk rett i lomma på de store selskapene i stedet for til forbrukerne.
example_english: The subsidies went straight into the pockets of the large companies instead of to consumers.

english: above all, most of all
example: Fremfor alt er det viktig å bevare tilliten mellom innbyggerne og de folkevalgte.
example_english: Above all it is important to preserve the trust between citizens and their elected representatives.

english: for better or worse, through thick and thin
example: Familien sto sammen på godt og vondt gjennom alle livets opp- og nedturer.
example_english: The family stood together for better or worse through all of life's ups and downs.

english: to lead the way, to set an example
example: Norge kan gå foran som et godt eksempel på bærekraftig energiomstilling for andre land.
example_english: Norway can lead the way as a good example of sustainable energy transition for other countries.

english: to give up, to forgo, to renounce
example: For å leve mer bærekraftig er mange villige til å gi avkall på visse luksusgoder.
example_english: In order to live more sustainably many people are willing to forgo certain luxury goods.

english: the state of things, the current situation
example: Rapporten gir et nedslående bilde av tingenes tilstand i den offentlige skolen.
example_english: The report paints a dispiriting picture of the state of things in the public school system.

english: to have the energy to, to have the capacity for
example: Etter en krevende arbeidsuke har jeg sjelden overskudd til å møte mange mennesker.
example_english: After a demanding working week I rarely have the energy to meet many people.

english: to be dependent on, to rely on
example: Mange kommuner er avhengige av statlige overføringer for å opprettholde gode tjenester.
example_english: Many municipalities are dependent on state transfers to maintain good services.

english: as a rule, usually, generally
example: Som regel løses de fleste konflikter bedre gjennom dialog enn gjennom konfrontasjon.
example_english: As a rule most conflicts are resolved better through dialogue than through confrontation.

english: so to speak, as it were, practically
example: Sosiale medier har så å si blitt en integrert del av det daglige livet til de unge.
example_english: Social media have, so to speak, become an integral part of young people's daily lives.

english: to settle down, to settle in a place
example: Etter mange år i utlandet valgte de å slå seg ned i en liten kystby i Sør-Norge.
example_english: After many years abroad they chose to settle down in a small coastal town in southern Norway.

english: nothing special, not up to much, mediocre
example: Maten var ikke noe videre, men atmosfæren på restauranten var veldig hyggelig.
example_english: The food was nothing special, but the atmosphere at the restaurant was very pleasant.

english: to adapt, to adjust, to organise one's life
example: Etter pensjoneringen tok det tid å innrette seg til en ny rytme uten faste arbeidsdager.
example_english: After retirement it took time to adjust to a new rhythm without regular working days.

english: at least, in any case, anyway
example: Jeg er ikke sikker, men i hvert fall bør vi prøve.
example_english: I am not sure, but in any case we should try.

english: to bring up, to raise (a topic)
example: Han tok opp spørsmålet om finansiering på møtet.
example_english: He brought up the question of funding at the meeting.

english: to refer to, to allude to
example: Hva sikter du til når du sier det?
example_english: What are you referring to when you say that?
